sections.shortTitle: Provincially Administered Tribal Areas Application of Laws Regulation 1972
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PROVINCIALLY ADMINISTERED TRIBAL AREAS (APPLICATION OF LAWS) REGULATION,
1972
PROVINCIALLY ADMINISTERED
TRIBAL AREAS (APPLICATION OF LAWS) REGULATION, 1972
1. Short title
and commencement.‑(1) This Regulation maybe called the Provincially
Administered Tribal Areas (Application of Laws) Regulation, 1972.
(2) It extends to the whole of the Provincially
Administered Tribal Areas of the North‑West Frontier Province and
Baluchistan.
(3) Is shall come into force at
once.

2. Application
of certain laws to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of N.‑W. F.
P. & Baluchistan.‑The laws specified in the Schedule shall apply
to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas or to the parts of those: Areas
to which they do not already apply.
